target.title: docs: turn Features into a capability explorer
target.body:
## Summary

- Reframe the Features index around reusable capabilities rather than providers or command syntax.
- Replace the long generated Markdown list with a polished, responsive capability explorer on `/features/`.
- Add a strong product-oriented hero, a Lease → Sync → Run → Prove flow, live search, category filters, result counts, and linked capability cards.
- Keep provider discovery in the canonical Provider Reference and command syntax in the Command Reference.
- Preserve every existing feature document and URL; the enhancement runs after the normal docs build and only transforms the Features landing page.

## Why

The docs now give Providers a first-class section, but the Features landing page still behaved like a dense Markdown inventory and duplicated adjacent information architecture. It was technically complete but difficult to scan, did not communicate the product workflow, and made dozens of capability guides feel flat and undifferentiated.

This change gives `/features/` one clear job: help a reader understand what Crabbox can do and quickly find the relevant capability contract.

## UX and accessibility

- Responsive three-, two-, and one-column card layouts.
- Searchable capability titles and descriptions.
- Filter pills for each capability area, with pressed state and live result counts.
- Keyboard-friendly native links, buttons, labels, and search input.
- Escape clears an active search.
- Empty-result status is announced and category sections hide only when they have no visible cards.
- Existing light/dark theme variables and reduced-motion behavior remain authoritative.
- Provider and command CTAs create an explicit handoff to the correct top-level section.

## Implementation

The shared Markdown renderer remains unchanged. `scripts/enhance-docs-site.mjs` deterministically post-processes only `dist/docs-site/features/index.html` after the normal build. This isolates the richer landing-page treatment from all other documentation pages and avoids committing generated output.

The Pages workflow and `scripts/check-docs.sh` both run the enhancement, so CI validates the same output that is deployed.

## Validation

- `node --check scripts/enhance-docs-site.mjs`
- `node --test scripts/enhance-docs-site.test.mjs`
- Enhancer regression coverage verifies the hero, search/filter surface, capability-card generation, TOC/pager removal, idempotence, and no-op behavior for unrelated pages.
- Branch is based directly on upstream `main` (`6da7760693a820c53434b4774077f526d362c136`) with no unrelated files.

Generated site output remains uncommitted.
